title: Rendley media results
description: One item per run. The fields of the Rendley job's output appear under their own names, result_data is parsed, and the raw job is included as job.

status.description: running when the run reached its Apify timeout while the job was still going (pick it up with job_id), completed or failed once it ended.

error.description: Why the run failed, when status is failed.

model_id.description: The model that was requested, when one was set.

project_id.description: The project the result was saved to, when one was set.

workspace_id.description: The workspace whose library holds the result, when no project was set.

job_id.description: The Rendley job that produced the result.

media_id.description: ID of the resulting file in Rendley; reuse it as source media or in the agent.

url.description: Signed download URL of the result, the same as the job's output.url in the Rendley API. Expires after a few hours.

credits.description: Estimated credits, when only the cost was requested.

kvs_key.description: Key of the copy stored in the run's key-value store.

size.description: Size of the result file in bytes.

duration.description: Duration of the result in seconds, for audio and video.

result_data.description: The job's result_data from the Rendley API, parsed. For transcribe it is the transcript with word timings.

job.description: The job exactly as the Rendley API returns it from GET /jobs/{id}.

note.description: Set when the run reached its timeout while the job was still going. Pick it up with job_id.
